## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the release gate before merging: with this change, a release that has exactly the required number of approvals is blocked. The generated catalog also contains a stray non-service key that should be removed.

## Changes
The pull request renames the 1,500 catalog entries from `legacy-service-NNNN` on ports 10000+ to `production-service-NNNN` on ports 20000+. It also rewrites `healthy()` as `not failures` and changes the approval comparison in `approved()` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in the approval check — Calling `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False`, because `return approvals > minimum` requires one approval more than the minimum. The module docstring at line 1 says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." — Every release that has exactly the configured minimum of approvals is blocked, and none of the current tests (3 vs. 2 and 1 vs. 2) catches this. — Fix: Change the comparison back to `approvals >= minimum`, and add an `approved(2, minimum=2)` case next to `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py`.

## Important
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the `review_note` key from the generated catalog — The diff adds a top-level `"review_note"` entry whose value is a string. Each of the other 1,500 top-level values is a `{"port", "enabled"}` object, so code that iterates the catalog and reads `entry["port"]` fails with `TypeError` on this key. — Any consumer of the catalog either fails on this entry or treats `review_note` as a service, and the file no longer matches what the generator produces.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- This review read the diff for `aaa-generated/catalog.json` only at diff lines 1–2233 and 8990–9009. The unread lines (2234–8989) were checked by pattern search only, which found 1,500 added `production-service-` keys.
- No consumers of `aaa-generated/catalog.json` or callers of `services.registry.healthy` exist in this repository, so their behaviour with the new catalog keys, the new ports, or a `None` failure list could not be checked.
